description: This file is a configuration script for a module bundler (likely Rollup or similar). It sets up path resolutions, external dependencies, and output options for building the 'canvas-host' application within the project. It primarily defines module resolution aliases and handles dynamic dependency resolution.

methods.name: resolveUiDependency
methods.description: Resolves a module ID to its path in either the ui node_modules or repo node_modules directory, throwing an error if not found.
